hero.titleRest: – The platform for digital AI employees.
hero.subtitleSuffix: – your digital employee for phone, WhatsApp, email and appointment management.

rolesSection.subtitle: Each role is specialised – together they cover your team's everyday work. Roles without "coming soon" are ready to use today.

roleDesc.reception: Answers calls, filters, forwards or gives information – around the clock, no hold music.
roleDesc.sales: Qualifies leads, answers initial questions and hands hot contacts straight to your team.
roleDesc.support: Answers FAQs via WhatsApp and web chat – in your brand's tone, in multiple languages.
roleDesc.orders: Takes orders and reservations, checks availability and confirms instantly.
roleDesc.office: Sorts emails, coordinates appointments and syncs calendars – no back-and-forth.
roleDesc.recruiting: Runs initial interviews with applicants, checks availability and books slots in your HR team's calendar.
roleDesc.collection: Sends friendly reminders about open invoices instead of acting like a collection agency.
roleDesc.onboarding: Guides new customers or employees through their first 30 days and answers early questions.
roleDesc.finance: Reads receipts and invoices and hands the data to your accounting.

dashboardSection.desc: Reservations, orders and calls come together centrally in your own dashboard – no notepads, no chaos between phone, WhatsApp and email.
features: All reservations, orders and calls in one central place
Notifications for new calls, reservations and orders
Weekly calendar and detail view at a glance
Listen back to call summaries and recordings directly
Update menu, opening hours and FAQ yourself at any time
dashboardSection.savedBasis: Based on: avg. €21/hour fully-loaded cost (salary, payroll costs & overhead)

platformSection.desc: Secure, GDPR-compliant and hosted in the EU. Kiwo runs on proven infrastructure — voice AI from Anthropic, telephony via Vapi, automated notifications via n8n.

roi.subtitle: Enter your numbers and see instantly how much time and money your digital employee frees up for phone, WhatsApp, email and appointment management — including ROI and payback.

rate.label: Fully-loaded hourly rate (€)
rate.hint: Salary, payroll costs & overhead per hour (industry average: €21).

missed.label: Missed calls/inquiries per week
missed.hint: Outside opening hours, busy line, or left unanswered. Also counts toward the call volume below.

regular.label: Regular calls/inquiries per week
regular.hint: Calls & chats Kiwo takes on in addition to the missed ones (reception, orders, support …).

duration.label: Avg. call duration
duration.hint: Determines how many call minutes are needed per month — and which plan really fits.

value.label: Avg. value per won contact (€)
value.hint: Revenue from an order, reservation, or job.

rescue.label: Rescue rate with Kiwo
rescue.hint: Share of otherwise lost inquiries that Kiwo catches and closes.

margin.label: Margin on extra revenue
margin.hint: Only this share of the extra revenue stays as real profit.

onboardingSection.subtitle: Often productive in under a week – no IT project required.

step1.title: Get in touch
step1.desc: You send us a quick message via the contact form, we get back to you.

step2.title: Joint setup
step2.desc: We set up Kiwo for your business and connect your channels (WhatsApp, calendar, phone).

step3.title: Kiwo takes over
step3.desc: All roles are active, you keep an eye on everything in the dashboard.

pricing.subtitle: You pay based on call volume, not on which roles are active. The first month is free.
features: Every unlocked role included in the price — no extra cost per role
Never miss a reservation or order again — everything live in your dashboard
Instant email alert the moment a guest calls, books, or orders
Your guest data stays in the EU — stored in full GDPR compliance
pricing.savedPersonnel: ≈ {{h}} hrs of staff time saved / month
pricing.footnote: All prices plus VAT. Used up your quota? An extra €0.20/minute — no call gets cut off, no automatic block. Want a custom package?
pricing.customDesc: Need more volume, multiple locations, or something specific? We'll put together a plan that fits.
